chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام used to say:

There is no harm in a young boy giving the adhan before he reaches puberty, but he should not lead the prayer until he reaches puberty. If he leads, his prayer is valid, but the prayer of the one who prays behind him is invalid.

key_terms.الْغُلَامُ: a young boy who has not yet reached puberty
key_terms.خَلْفَهُ: behind him, as a follower in prayer
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: to lead others as Imam in congregational prayer
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنَ: to give the adhan, the call to prayer

ai.seo_question: Can a boy who has not reached puberty give the adhan or lead congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the role of a prepubescent boy in congregational salat. It permits him to give the adhan before puberty, but does not permit him to serve as Imam for others in prayer; if he does, his own salat is valid while the salat of those following him is invalid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1170 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"There is no problem if a young boy (who has not yet reached puberty) gives the adhan (call to prayer), but he should not lead the prayer until he has reached puberty. If he leads, his own prayer is valid, but the prayer of those who follow him is invalid."
